'''The Dive''' was a bar located in [[Drepplin]], the capital city of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]]. The bar was known for its frequent and severe fights. All forms of [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] were also practiced there, with rigged [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] games being a favorite of the house.
